small-business.title: Small business
small-business.description: Customers, the quotes you give them, jobs and a balance sheet, linked to each other, with a dashboard and a weekly plan.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.markdown:
> [!NOTE]
> Jobs, quotes, customers and the balance sheet on one screen. The widgets follow the databases as they change.

Add your customers first, then the quotes you give them. When a quote is accepted, add a job and link it to the quote and the customer. Enter the balance sheet with the day you count it: the widgets show this month's entries.

widgets.jobsByPerson: Open jobs by person and priority

sprints.title: Sprints
sprints.description: Tasks planned in two-week sprints: the current sprint on a board, sprint planning and a backlog.
sprints.markdown: Plan the team's work in two-week sprints. **Current sprint** shows this sprint's tasks by status, **Sprint planning** the tasks of each sprint to come, and **Backlog** the tasks no sprint has yet. When a sprint ends, open **Sprints** in the database's menu and choose **Complete sprint**: the next sprint starts and unfinished tasks move to it.

docs.title: Docs
docs.description: How-tos, reference and policies in one place, with a category, an owner and when each was last edited.
docs.markdown: Every doc is a page in the library below, with its category and owner. When you have checked that a doc is right, choose **Verify page** in its menu: search ranks verified docs first and marks them, `is:verified` finds only them, and the AI chat prefers them.

writing.title: How we write docs
writing.markdown:
## Summary

One doc for one topic, written for someone new to it.

## Details

- Start with what the reader needs to do.
- Keep steps short and in order.
- Name an owner, and verify the doc when you have checked it.

onboarding.title: First week checklist
onboarding.markdown:
## Summary

What a new teammate does in their first week.

## Details

- [ ] Set up your accounts
- [ ] Meet your team
- [ ] Read the docs of your area

release.title: Release process
release.markdown:
## Summary

How a change goes from review to customers.

## Details

1. Review and merge the change.
2. Test it on the staging server.
3. Release it and tell the team.

expenses.title: Expense policy
expenses.markdown:
## Summary

What the company pays for and how to claim it.

## Details

- Keep the receipt.
- Claim within 30 days.
- Ask your manager before spending more than usual.
